# CQ-HECS: Full Technical Reference for LLM Context Ingestion

Project: CQ-HECS (Classical Quantum High-Efficiency Compute Simulator)
Author: Tim (@timfromhcs) <timfromhcs@gmail.com>
Repository: https://github.com/timfromhcs/CQ-HECS

---

## 1. System Architecture & Module Design

CQ-HECS operates as a classical quantum circuit simulation engine and algebraic constraint solver. Its execution model avoids silent bond-dimension cutoffs through an adaptive four-path routing architecture backed by Vulkan 1.3 SPIR-V compute shaders.

### Core Functional Modules

#### 1. VulkanComputeScheduler & Dynamic Pipeline
Manages queue submissions, memory barriers, and shader dispatch across Vulkan 1.3 physical devices (AMD, Intel, NVIDIA, Apple Silicon via MoltenVK). Embedded SPIR-V shaders execute tensor contractions and ring operations natively.

#### 2. ARX Modular Decomposition (Algebraic SAT Testbench)
Decomposes 64-bit addition into linear and carry terms for algebraic step verification:
- Sum(A, B) = A ^ B
- CarryShadow(A, B) = (A & B) << 1
- (A + B) mod 2^64 = Sum(A, B) + CarryShadow(A, B) mod 2^64
Serves as an algebraic SAT verification testbench for reduced rounds of standard primitives (ChaCha20: 20 rounds specification, SHA-256: 64 steps specification, BLAKE2b: 12 rounds specification). It does not claim full cryptographic preimage extraction.

#### 3. Exact Giles-Selinger Ring Z[1/sqrt(2), i]
Bit-exact arithmetic over the dyadic cyclotomic ring for Clifford+T quantum gates:
- Element form: (a + b*sqrt(2) + c*i + d*i*sqrt(2)) / (sqrt(2)^k), where a, b, c, d in Z, k in N.
- Eliminates floating-point cancellation drift: constructive ((k1 - k2) == 0 mod 8) and destructive ((k1 - k2) == 4 mod 8) interference are evaluated with exact integer arithmetic.
- Unitary integrity: U^dagger U = Identity is strictly maintained.

#### 4. Propositional SAT & O(1) Cuckoo Cycle Pruning
DPLL solver for CNF satisfiability. Computes 64-bit Murmur3 state signatures and caches branch states in a dual-bucket Cuckoo hash table to detect and prune cycle loops in O(1) amortized time.

#### 5. Vulkan Matrix Product State (MPS) Engine (Path C)
1D Matrix Product State representation supporting dynamic bond dimension chi without silent cutoffs:
- Area-Law states (e.g. 300-qubit GHZ with chi=2) consume < 5 MB resident VRAM.
- Volume-Law states (exponential entropy S ~ L/2): When the memory ceiling is reached, execution refuses uncertified truncation and escalates to Path D or flags unresolved=True.

#### 6. Heisenberg Sparse-Pauli-Dynamics (Path D)
Evolves target observables backwards under Heisenberg dynamics: O(t) = U^dagger O U = sum_P c_P P.
- Controlled pruning of terms below coefficient threshold: Delta_trunc = sum_{P in D} |c_P|.
- Certified bound: |<psi| O_exact |psi> - <psi| O_approx |psi>| <= Delta_trunc.
- If Delta_trunc > epsilon_tolerance, the result is marked unresolved=True without guessing.

---

## 2. Public C-ABI Interface (`include/cq_hecs_api.h`)

```c
typedef struct cq_context cq_context_t;

typedef struct {
    uint32_t gate_count;
    uint32_t qubit_count;
    double   elapsed_ms;
    double   active_vram_mb;
    double   lambda_res;
    int      success;
} cq_result_t;

typedef struct {
    int      satisfiable;      // 1 = SAT, 0 = UNSAT
    uint32_t num_vars;
    uint32_t num_clauses;
    uint32_t decisions;
    uint32_t pruned_cycles;
    double   elapsed_ms;
    int      verified;
    int8_t   assignment[1024]; // 1 = True, 0 = False, -1 = Unassigned
} cq_sat_result_t;

CQ_API cq_context_t* cq_create_context(uint32_t num_qubits, uint32_t bond_dim);
CQ_API int cq_execute_qasm(cq_context_t* ctx, const char* qasm_str, cq_result_t* out_result);
CQ_API int cq_solve_sat(const char* cnf_str, cq_sat_result_t* out_result);
CQ_API int cq_invert_arx(const char* primitive, uint32_t rounds, const uint64_t* target, uint64_t* out_preimage);
CQ_API void cq_destroy_context(cq_context_t* ctx);
CQ_API const char* cq_get_version(void);
CQ_API double cq_get_active_vram_mb(cq_context_t* ctx);
```

---

## 3. CLI Command Reference & Exit Codes

```bash
# OpenQASM Simulation
./build/bin/cq_hecs qasm benchmarks/qasm/ghz_300.qasm --json

# SAT Constraint Solving
./build/bin/cq_hecs sat benchmarks/sat/pigeonhole_6_5.cnf --json
# Exit codes: 0 = SAT, 10 = UNSAT, 1 = Error

# ARX Constraint-Analyse auf Standardspezifikationen
./build/bin/cq_hecs arx blake2b --rounds 12 --json
./build/bin/cq_hecs arx chacha20 --rounds 20 --json
./build/bin/cq_hecs arx sha256 --rounds 64 --json

# Stress Test
./build/bin/cq_hecs stress --cycles 100000 --json

# Interactive TUI Monitor
./build/bin/cq_hecs dashboard [--cycles N]

# Self-Test
./build/bin/cq_hecs test --json
```

---

## 4. Scientific Capabilities vs. Known Boundaries

| Capability | Scope & Verification | Known Boundary / Non-Goal |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Clifford Simulation | Exact O(N^2) Stabilizer Tableau | Non-universal without T-gates |
| Stabilizer Rank | Exact decomposition for T <= 14 | Exponential scaling O(2^{alpha T}) |
| Vulkan MPS | Exact Area-Law states (GHZ chi=2 < 5MB) | Volume-Law states escalate or halt |
| Sparse-Pauli (Path D) | Certified error bound Delta <= sum \|c_P\| | Fails gracefully if bound > tolerance |
| ARX SAT Analysis | Reduced-round algebraic testbench | No full-cipher cryptographic preimage break |
